# Bundled session-mode dependencies

No CDN requests are made on page load. Files were extracted from official npm archives:

- marked 12.0.2: `package/marked.min.js`, MIT license.
  Archive integrity: `sha512-qXUm7e/YKFoqFPYPa3Ukg9xlI5cyAtGmyEIzMfW//m6kXwCy2Ps9DYf5ioijFKQ8qyuscrHoY04iJGctu2Kg0Q==`
- DOMPurify 3.4.16: `package/dist/purify.min.js`, Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0 license.
  Archive integrity: `sha512-sqo+pNp3qRhCIpbgRi1y8Tgk27Bo2Ry7w0dC1NBeNTdZChWjz9Xb/KOoZbRP/R6pQZ80Qw8YhXw13hWWBbMRnQ==`

Full licenses accompany the files. HTML generated by marked always passes through DOMPurify.
These files do not require npm or Node at runtime.
